profile.headline: Senior Brand + UX/Digital Designer. Art Director + Writer. Web Developer.
profile.jobTitle: Senior Designer, Art Director, Web Developer
profile.summary: I'm a creative professional with 15+ years of diverse experience. I specialize in art direction and branding, web/UX/UI/graphic design, editorial design, front-end web development, and copy writing and editing. I've had the pleasure of executing impactful work in several industries (advertising, healthcare, technology, automotive, publishing, manufacturing, real estate, non-profit, B2B, B2C, SaaS) and my clients/partnerships include BMW, Gilead, USA Today Inc., ThermoFisher Scientific, Sangamo Therapeutics, Beckman Coulter, Medtronic, American Library Association, Jones Lang LaSalle, Creative Circle, Robert Half, Our Next Energy, Piston Automotive, State of Michigan, and State of West Virginia.

positions.title: Senior Designer, Art Director, Web Developer
positions.description:
Client industries: advertising + marketing, healthcare, technology, life sciences, automotive, media, publishing, education, manufacturing, real estate, non-profit, B2B, B2C / D2C, e-commerce, SaaS, software development, start-ups.
Clients + partnerships include BMW, Gilead, Gannett | USA Today Network, American Library Association, ThermoFisher Scientific, Beckman Coulter, Medtronic, Jones Lang LaSalle, Creative Circle, Robert Half, Hillard Heintze.
13+ years of diverse experience. specializing in art direction + branding, web / UX / UI / graphic design, editorial design, front-end web development, and copy writing + editing.
Projects executed: Marketing collateral, web / email / app / UX / UI, digital ads, logo, branding, icons + infographics, presentations, packaging, social media.

positions.description:
Branding + identity, graphic + digital design, UX/UI, logo, web + email, UX/UI, social media, presentation design, copy writing + copy editing, website management, asset management, photography, photo retouching.
